label: DemoForm

items.label: Welcome to the Demo Form
items.name: WELCOME
items.description:
This form demonstrates all the **different types of questionnaire items** that can be included in a form.

* text and numeric inputs
* date and time inputs
* select inputs
* geographical data inputs
* sections and groups
* validation, condition rules
* computed values
* ...

Visit the [Form items documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/index.html) for more details.

items.label: Data capture
items.name: DATA_CAPTURE
items.description: Different ways of capturing data.

items.label: Text types
items.name: TEXTS
items.description: Questionnaire items that capture text entries.

items.label: Short answer
items.name: SHORT_ANSWER
items.description: Answer is a short text. Visit the [Short answer documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/short-answer.html) for more details.

items.label: Short answer
items.name: SHORT_ANSWER_MASKED
items.description: Answer is a short text with an input mask. Visit the [Short answer documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/short-answer.html) for more details.

items.label: Paragraph
items.name: PARAGRAPH
items.description: The text can be long, with multiple lines. Visit the [Paragraph documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/paragraph.html) for more details.

items.label: Checks
items.name: CHECKS

items.label: Single choice
items.name: SINGLE_CHOICE
items.description: Select one predefined value. Visit the [Single choice documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/single-choice.html) for more details.

items.label: Multiple choices
items.name: MULTIPLE_CHOICES
items.description: Select one or more predefined values. Visit the [Multiple choices documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/multiple-choices.html) for more details.
Select values from radios or check boxes.

items.label: Selects
items.name: SELECTS

items.label: Dropdown (single choice)
items.name: DROPDOWN_S
items.description: Select one predefined value from a dropdown. Visit the [Dropdown documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/dropdown.html).

items.label: Dropdown (multiple choices)
items.name: DROPDOWN_M
items.description: Select several predefined values from a dropdown. Visit the [Dropdown documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/dropdown.html).

items.label: Image select
items.name: IMAGE
items.description: Select a value by clicking on an image area. Visit the [Image Select documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/image-select.html).
Select values from a select widget.

items.label: Auto complete
items.name: AUTOCOMPLETES

items.label: Auto complete (single choice)
items.name: AUTOCOMPLETE_S
items.description: Select one predefined value from an autocomplete field. Visit the [Auto Complete documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/auto-complete.html) for more details.

items.label: Auto complete (multiple choices)
items.name: AUTOCOMPLETE_M
items.description: Select one predefined value from an autocomplete field. Visit the [Auto Complete documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/auto-complete.html) for more details.
Type some text to filter the list of predefined values.

items.label: Numeric types
items.name: NUMERICS

items.label: Number
items.name: NUMBER
items.description: Type a numeric value, can be integer or decimal. Visit the [Number documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/number.html) for more details.

items.label: Slider
items.name: SLIDER
items.description: Slide the cursor to select an integer value. The range of values is configurable. Visit the [Slider documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/slider.html) for more details.

items.label: Rating
items.name: RATING
items.description: The more icons selected, the higher the value. Icon and maximum value are configurable. Visit the [Rating documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/rating.html) for more details.
Enter or select a number

items.label: Temporal types
items.name: TEMPORALS
items.description: Select dates and times in a ISO 8601 compatible format (yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm).

items.label: Date
items.name: DATE
items.description: Select a date in a Gregorian calendar. Visit the [Date documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/date.html) for more details.

items.label: Time
items.name: TIME
items.description: Select a date in 24h format. Visit the [Time documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/time.html) for more details.

items.label: Date and time
items.name: DATE_TIME
items.description: Select a date and a time in a single field. Visit the [Date and Time documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/datetime.html) for more details.

items.label: Point
items.name: POINT
items.description: Select a position. Visit the [Geographic data documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/geo-data.html) for more details.

items.label: Polygon
items.name: POLYGON
items.description: Select a geographic area. Visit the [Geographic data documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/geo-data.html) for more details.

items.label: Toggle
items.name: TOGGLE
items.description: Select a logical value. Visit the [Toggle documentation](https://amberdoc.obiba.org/en/latest/studio-user-guide/content/items/toggle.html) for more details.

items.label: Data processing
items.name: DATA_PROCESS
items.description: Process captured data for validation, condition and computation.

items.name: VALIDATIONS

items.label: Required

items.name: DATE
items.description: Validate that the input date is in the future.
items.validationMessage: The date must be in the future.

items.label: Slider
items.name: SLIDER
items.description: Select a reference value.

items.label: Number
items.name: NUMBER
items.description: Number to validate relatively to the Slider's input value.
items.validationMessage: The value must be strictly lower than the Slider's one.

items.description: Validation is about defining a rule that constraints the input value. A form with invalid fields cannot be completed.

items.label: Conditions
items.name: CONDITIONS
items.description: A condition is a rule that drives the visibility of a field. When a field is not visible there is no value associated.

items.label: Binary answer
items.name: YESNO
items.description: Either select Yes or No to trigger visibility of other fields.

items.name: NO
items.description: Ok, you said No, let's forget it then.

items.label: Computations
items.name: COMPUTATIONS

items.label: Computed
items.name: COMP
items.description: Computed field

items.name: COMP_MSG1
items.description: The addition of Slider 1 and Slider 2 values is **below 10**.

items.name: COMP_MSG2
items.description: The addition of Slider 1 and Slider 2 values is **equal or higher than 10**.
A value can be computed based on other values. There is no representation of a computed item. Its value can be used in another item's condition or validation rule.
